d:
Bihar men subah aur rat ke samay thand ka ehsas barhne laga hai, jabki din men dhup se tapman samany bana huaa hai.
Mausam vibhag ke mutabik agle 72 ghante tak kaee ilakon men halke se madhyam kohre ki sanbhavna hai, vahin 21 navanbar ko kuchh jilon men barish ho sakti hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
